title: tau3 retail tool agent optimization
notes: Model roles, as in the paper runs: the agent under test and the user simulator both call the RUNTIME provider and model at the RUNTIME effort through the evaluator broker (tau3_runtime.py llm_agent and llm_user), so user-simulator calls count toward each row's runtime call and token budget. Requests on the chat-completions path (here only the NL-assertion evaluator) get the JUDGE effort and output floor on the same provider and model; of the JUDGE role only its effort is used.
Per-host guard: at most 4 concurrent Optimization runs.
Evaluator brokers reach the RUNTIME provider directly (Responses wire) with a key file mounted only into them, as in the paper's Lite runs; Chat-only runtime providers need the unified broker here.

Release change (2026-10-11): runners/optimization/adapter.py collect_eval treats an Eval trial that Harbor ended with an exception before the evaluator wrote its score contract (for example an environment start or verifier timeout on a loaded Docker host) as an infrastructure failure of the evaluation, as collect_candidate already did for Candidate trials, so the infrastructure resume replays it: the dev controller replays a dev evaluation as a new phase, and a held-out phase resumes. Before, the missing contract raised FileNotFoundError, which was not classified as infrastructure: a dev evaluation was dropped (the Builder had to submit again) and a held-out evaluation ended the run. A trial whose contract exists is scored from that contract as before, and a missing contract without a Harbor trial exception still fails the phase.

Release change (2026-10-11): an evaluation phase that raises closes its controller_logs/<phase>/infrastructure_resume_state.json (status infrastructure_error or failed, finished_at and the error). `agentswe status` reads the dev controller's last error from both of its record shapes (a resume pause: error_type, at, error_message; a submission that ended: infrastructure_error, finished_at) and shows the phase `baseline` while the starter is evaluated; `agentswe result` adds evaluation_phase_status. `agentswe stop` also removes the run's containers that mount its Harbor job directories under <home>/jobs or whose compose working directory or compose files are under the run directory (an exited verifier container was left behind before); it never selects containers by name, and other runs in the same home are not matched.
